communities.name: Orania, The Valley
communities.trend: Peaked Q1 2026 at 1,464 psf, now ~1,387. Down about 5% off peak.
communities.read: Capital growth phase closing. 42% of the community has traded, flippers made a median +27.8% over 14 months. Sell from strength, buy on negotiation.

communities.name: Elora, The Valley
communities.trend: Thin data, 16 title deeds Apr to Jul 2026. Flat.
communities.read: Trades below Orania. DLD valuation for 3BR Type B 2,180 sqft is 2.50 to 2.58M. Anything above 2.6M needs a specific reason.

communities.name: Rivana, The Valley
communities.trend: 3BR psf up from 945 in 2024 to 1,055 in 2025, about +12%.
communities.read: 4 beds are the depth here, 3 beds are rare and the newest 3BR print is Nov 2025 so do not quote them as live comps.

communities.name: Farm Gardens, The Valley
communities.trend: 197 transactions since Jan 2023. 146 developer sales, 51 owner resales.
communities.read: Resales are up a median 22% on original developer price, range +4% to +48%. 5 beds sit on 10,000 sqft plots, 4 beds 8,500 to 9,800. Only 42 of 146 owners have exited.

communities.name: Nima, The Valley
communities.read: Deepest 3 bed market in The Valley. Registry only holds 34 of 206 traded units, so most owners here you cannot call yet.

communities.name: Lillia, The Valley
communities.read: Cheapest 3 bed townhouse entry in The Valley on psf. 43 traded units are missing from your owner registry.
